events.title: Demo 0.7 Update
events.summary: This patch was a tough one. I've been grinding on this for the better part of this last year. Leaving this game in silence for a year was not a conscious decision but life mandated it. After a merciless year I am glad to have been able to improve this to the point where I feel comfortable to let out another update, striking some goals out and leaving space to head for the rest of them. events.title: Playtest build 0.7
events.summary: After more than a year of nothingness i've finally managed to get something relatively finished for the next build. There are still stuff I need to revisit but the majority of the changes are there.Texts will have to be revisited, ships need to be rebalanced and some new cards need to be introduced before this build is ready but its a start.A lot of changes have come and I'll try to prepare a proper changelog for the proper release.

events.title: Demo Update 0.6
events.summary: After a couple of months of work the update for the Demo is ready.The original Demo lacked in a lot of aspects but it was successful at starting to bring in feedback.This update addressees that feedback and expands on the game's features.The card fight in the original version lacked and couldn't really be called a card fight. The complete system and UI of it has been reworked and now should create some more interesting experiences i hope.There's been a lot of polishes in the way the ship control

events.title: Playtest from version 0.6 released
events.summary: The past couple for months after releasing the original demo for Metal Coffin I've managed to gather a lot of feedback and got to see a lot of the shortcomings of the game.The 0.6 update aims to fix a lot of those and give the game some identity.To anyone who gets to try it I'd love to hear your thoughts.Full release of the demo build is expected in upcoming weeks.

events.title: Metal Coffin official Discord server
events.summary: While trying to keep the history of the updates in one place i thought it would be a nice idea to finally set up a proper discord server. I was blessed enough to also find a couple of people who wished to help with the development and do some sporadic tests on updates i created, that was another reason a central hub was needed. With all this in mind it made sense to put the word out of the server's existence. To anyone interested i'd love to have you there. Discord Invite : https://discord.gg/sr
